Use case: ui-mockup. Produce a single polished, high-fidelity desktop product UI image for the existing Chinese Compass web app, using the supplied REAL SCREENSHOT as the authoritative visual reference. Match its distinctive 60px icon rail, pale sage secondary sidebar, fine outline icons, top breadcrumb, warm near-white canvas #F8F9F6, white surfaces, dark charcoal-green text #202B27, muted #62716A, deep forest green #1C5145 primary buttons, pale selected fill #E5EEE7, subtle 1px #DCE2DA borders, restrained 7-10px radii, compact Chinese system sans typography and generous but functional spacing. Preserve the existing product shell, icon language and navigation labels; adapt the canvas to a landscape desktop approximately 1600x1100 so content is readable. This is a faithful next-state product mockup, no browser chrome, no device mockup, no poster title, no numbered annotations, no invented decorative graphics, no giant dashboard metrics, no marketing copy, no mouse cursor or Next.js dev badge. Crisp legible Chinese and Latin text. Do not add real credentials. Keep sample data obviously benign. Small quiet footer outside the content card: “交互设计稿 · 示例数据”. All UI controls must look practical, consistently aligned, with clear hierarchy.
Screen: platform administrator model provider list. Keep secondary sidebar “管理与治理” with “Agent 与能力” selected and top tabs “主 Agent / 工具策略 / Skill 与流程 / 模型路由 / 代码环境 / 协同策略”, 模型路由 selected. Header “Agent 与能力”, subtitle “统一管理平台模型，向各租户开放使用。” Change top right workspace context to “平台管理”, bottom sidebar context “Compass 平台”. Replace the old empty-state card with a refined provider management table. Card header “模型 Provider” and small badge “平台配置”, right aligned dark green “＋ 添加 Provider”. Below: search placeholder “搜索别称或模型名称”, compact filters “全部类型”, “全部状态”. Table columns: 别称 / 模型名称 / 类型 / 接入状态 / Chat 展示 / 最近测试 / 操作. Exactly 3 rows, no extras: row 1 “经营分析”, “deepseek v4 pro”, LLM tag, green “启用”, green on toggle, “同步 · 成功”, text actions “编辑  测试  停用”; row 2 “快速分析”, “deepseek v4.1 flash”, LLM tag, “启用”, on toggle, “流式 · 成功”, “编辑  测试  停用”; row 3 “决策判断”, “decision-model-preview”, secondary supplier “阿里云”, pale “决策模型” tag, muted “停用”, off toggle, “未测试”, “编辑  测试  启用”. Green success styling restrained. Use a stacked model name with vendor below where necessary. API keys never appear in this table. Footer “共 3 条” and pagination. Below table one restrained help line “已启用且在 Chat 中展示的模型可供获权租户使用。” Keep wide blank breathing space below like reference. A plausible mature shipped page with very readable table.
